environment.description: Service deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No NLB or ALB in front. Route table has internet gateway route. WebSocket endpoint directly accessible from the internet at ws://[EIP]:8443/ws.

config.network: VPC 10.0.0.0/16, public subnet 10.0.1.0/24 with IGW route
config.security_group: sg-0abc123: inbound TCP 8443 from 0.0.0.0/0, outbound all
config.dns: ws.realtime.example.com -> EIP via Route53 A record
